summary: Frontend-only test of 4 investor enhancements (CBAM preview, audit summary CSV/HTML, passport copy/share, supplier drilldown) plus regression on golden path and public verify. All acceptance criteria passed.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is a single 43-line minified-style file with entire app inline; hard to maintain. Consider splitting into components (Login, AppShell, CBAM, CompanyInteractive, Passport, AuditSummary, PublicVerify) for readability, though functionally correct.

downloadAudit HTML flow uses target=_blank on a synthesized anchor; in Playwright Chromium it opened as a popup successfully. In some browsers/pop-up blockers this may silently fail — consider window.open with a data URL fallback.

sharePassport relies on navigator.share (undefined in desktop Chromium) and falls back to clipboard; behavior is correct but the toast message is identical to the copy button in that fallback, which may confuse users. Consider distinct wording (e.g., 'Share unavailable — link copied instead').
Passport IDs are hard-coded fallback ('SAU-NSC-08-4F2A') if data.passport is undefined in copy/share — acceptable for demo but worth flagging.
seed_data_creation: none (demo state pre-seeded; passport was already issued from prior iterations, per task note)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 investor enhancements pass. Supplier drawer opens/closes properly with correct completeness/assumption/status for all 4 suppliers (Novi Logistics red-text 'Correction open' confirmed). CBAM select changes update exposure (€27,300 Aluminium / €9,860 Copper) and year label ('2028 scenario · simulated'). CSV download named saurient-audit-summary.csv contains 'Northstar Components' and 'Scope 1'; HTML popup opens with expected title. Copy passport writes /verify/<id> URL to clipboard and shows toast; share falls back to clipboard on Chromium (no crash). Public verify /verify/<id> shows VERIFIED, unknown id shows UNVERIFIABLE. Mobile 390x844 has no horizontal overflow on CBAM/suppliers/audit views.
